method.scope: One extracted plain-text paragraph, exact first and last eight tokens for each consecutive indexed paragraph.
method.attribution: Unique complete sequence of three or more paragraph edges, followed by the unchanged archive fingerprint checks on every recovered span.
method.known_edit: Replace one interior alphabetic token in the third paragraph with a distinct word already present in the same document.
method.selection: Up to five work groups per pinned volume in deterministic hash order, excluding earlier queried works, exact 12-word overlaps and repeated sender keys within this panel. Prefer sender keys absent from prior queries. One extra archive-absent group per volume where eligible.
method.controls: Same-work reversed paragraphs, one paragraph from another source, added unrelated introduction, quote marker, out-of-index and duplicated library entries.
method.advance: At least 12 independent indexed work groups, at least 75% of all exact normalized originals and known edits, and zero incorrect attributions or differences on identical flattened copies.

alteration_test: Rejected one code-point shift in a changed token.
